specification.outcome: When a user asks in normal conversation to create an ordinary ticket, Tiber publishes an unclaimed Backlog task without requiring or changing a campaign.

scenarios.name: create with no campaign checkpoint
then: metadata parses before host generates one task UUID,event UUID,canonical UTC time
host constructs/freeze-once existing task-created event and GitTaskRemote publishes unchanged values
projected task is Backlog/unclaimed/unspecified/campaignProvenance none and no campaign adapter method runs

scenarios.name: create while unrelated campaign active
given: title 'Fix lag' and description 'Render activity immediately' pass parsers
then: ordinary task-created event publishes with only id,title,description task fields
campaign checkpoint bytes unchanged and no campaign adapter method runs
projected campaignProvenance is {kind:'none'}

scenarios.name: reject malformed request without side effects
given: kind is unknown; or an extra key exists; or kind,title,or description is missing,null,or wrong type
then: TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID returns
no metadata parser shell,UUID,clock,task remote,readiness,claim,run journal,worktree,or campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: reject invalid metadata before authority generation
given: a schema-valid create-task request has title or description rejected by existing parser
then: TIBER_TASK_VALUE_INVALID returns before UUID/clock generation
no task remote,readiness,claim,run journal,worktree,or campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: reject publication failures by phase
given: metadata valid and host-generated event fixed
when: board pre-read or remote history verification fails, signer is unavailable, signing/push retries exhaust four attempts, or post-push observation/projection is degraded,missing,or inconsistent
then: TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID returns with no success result

pre-read/configured-signer/history/fold failures return without retry; signing execution and push rejection retry within existing maximum four attempts; degraded post-push observation returns without claiming success
no campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: route ordinary ticket language
given: user says 'Add a ticket: Fix the startup lag' or 'Create a ticket titled Fix lag with description Render activity immediately'
then: payload is respectively create-task with description '' or create-task with supplied description
campaign-goal and begin-task are not used

scenarios.name: ask for missing title without a tool call
given: user says only 'Create a ticket' and no title can be inferred
then: Pi makes no workflow tool call and responds 'I need a ticket title before I can create it.'
no request or effect occurs

scenarios.name: preserve explicit and mixed campaign routing
given: user says 'Start a campaign to finish every backlog ticket', 'Add a ticket to fix campaign scheduling', or ambiguously 'Start a campaign and add a ticket'
then: first uses campaign-start and not create-task; second uses create-task because campaign is subject matter,not requested operation; third makes no tool call and asks which operation to perform first
existing explicit campaign semantics retain precedence

scenarios.name: return success only from exact projection
given: task-created event published and board projection writable
when: host looks up generated task ID
then: success requires exact title,description,state Backlog,specification none,claim none,campaign provenance none
content is 'Task created: <taskId>\nBacklog | unspecified | unclaimed' and details is {disposition:'created',taskId,state:'Backlog',specification:'unspecified',claim:'unclaimed'}
missing or inconsistent projection returns TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID

acceptanceCriteria: Workflow request exact shape {kind:'create-task',title:string,description:string}; every key required, no extras. Unknown kind, extra key, and missing/null/wrong type for each required field are covered independently.
Metadata parsing is the first host dispatch step and reuses parseTaskTitle/parseTaskDescription unchanged. Empty description valid. No authority values/effect adapters before both parse.

Exact TaskCreatedEvent is {schemaVersion:1,eventId,kind:'task-created',occurredAt,task:{id,title,description}}. It contains no campaign field or Option. foldTaskEvents derives campaignProvenance:{kind:'none'} and all other defaults.

Host parses randomUUID outputs through existing task/event UUID parsers and Date output through occurrence parser, constructs the nested event once outside GitTaskRemote, deep-freezes it, and passes unchanged deep values through every remote retry; reference identity is not part of contract.

Projected task exact defaults: state Backlog,blockStatus unblocked,specification/specificationDigest/claim/finalReviewProgress/completionRelease/delivery/ci/openedReview/reviewReceipt/campaignProvenance each {kind:'none'},preservedIncrements [], and requested metadata/ID.

Create branch has no runtime calls to FileCampaignStore, handleCampaignCommand, readiness reviewer, handleWorkCommand, FileRunJournal, or GitOwnedWorktrees. Tests inject spies at those module boundaries and assert zero calls for no-checkpoint,active-campaign,denials,and success.

Failure phases retain GitTaskRemote behavior: degraded pre-read/configured signer absence/invalid verified history/invalid fold return immediately; runtime signing or push failures are caught and retried up to four total attempts using same event; degraded observation after a push returns immediately. Any final degraded board, absent task, or mismatched projection maps TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID and never success.

Routing precedence: explicit single campaign-start intent wins; explicit single ticket-create intent wins even when title discusses campaigns; mixed requests for both operations require clarification and no call; omitted description becomes ''; omitted title requires exact guidance and no call.
Success result exact text/details follows scenario and occurs only after independent writable projection matches generated ID and defaults.
Registered TypeBox schema, core parser, workflow guidance, dispatcher, and result capture add create-task while campaign request schemas and behavior remain unchanged.
